newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas up in April-CVM.
newsitem.headline: Foreign inflows into Brazil bolsas up in April-CVM.

text.p: Net foreign capital inflows into Brazilian stock exchanges under Annex Four rules totalled $601.7 million in April, up from $599.3 million in the previous month, Brazil's Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) said.
Foreign buys were $2.601 billion, while foreign sales totalled $1.999 billion, it said in a statement.
So far this year, net foreign investment has amounted to $2.899 billion.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazilian stocks, debentures and privatization bonds.
